title: Expose public transaction API on Db (issue #16)
description: Add transaction<T>(fn: (tx: Db) => Promise<T>) to the public Db interface, backed by pglite.transaction(). Retype execute() to a structural QueryExecutor; add DbImpl.transaction() holding the inFlight lock; add non-exported TxDb handle with savepoint-based nesting; tx.close() throws. Add vitest coverage and a Docusaurus docs page. Closes GH issue #16.
close_reason: Implemented db.transaction() with savepoint nesting, tests, and docs on branch feat/transaction-api (commit d669005)
